items.summary: Updated casualty figures for the overnight Russian strike wave on Ukraine's energy infrastructure: at least six people killed — a multistorey building strike in Kyiv's Desnianskyi district killed two, another in Golosiivsky district killed one (per Ukraine's state emergency service); two more killed and six wounded in the Dnipropetrovsk region, one killed in Zaporizhzhia. Missile attacks also reported in Kharkiv, Zhytomyr, Sumy and Chernihiv regions. Mayor Klitschko urged residents to remain in shelters; DTEK reported emergency power cuts in several Kyiv districts after the 'massive' ballistic missile strike (Russia's Defence Ministry claimed 7 energy facilities + a Kyiv data centre hit). Separately, Moscow mayor Sobyanin said Russian air defences downed nearly 500 Ukrainian drones heading for the capital overnight, with the Russian military claiming 902 drones downed nationwide.
items.title: Overnight Oct 13-14 strike-wave toll rises: at least six killed across Ukraine
